query:
SELECT ca.id, ca.clientName, ca.businessName, ca.assignedTechnicianId, t.name as repName, t.openId as repOpenId, t.status as repStatus
FROM client_accounts ca
LEFT JOIN technicians t ON t.id = ca.assignedTechnicianId
ORDER BY ca.id;
